approvalMessage.text:
APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 29 Chapter 645
 
       MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 804-C, entitled:
 
    "AN  ACT  to amend the general business law, in relation to consumer
        litigation funding"
 
    APPROVED
 
  The bill increases protections for individuals who engage in  consumer
litigation  funding transactions, by creating a regulatory structure for
such transactions, including standardized contractual  terms,  mandatory
disclosure requirements, and registration requirements.
 
  I  support the goals of ensuring that individuals who enter into liti-
gation funding agreements to advance their legal claims are afforded key
consumer protections, including standardized and  mandatory  disclosures
of  the  funded  amount,  repayment framework and limits on charges. The
bill as drafted required amendments to make clear, among  other  things,
the  required  disclosures  and contractual rights/duties as well as the
consumer's obligation to pay charges. Additionally, the bill was amended
to clarify that the litigation funding companies shall register with and
report to the Department of Financial Services. I have reached an agree-
ment with the Legislature to enact these changes. On the basis  of  this
agreement, I am pleased to sign this bill.
 
  This bill is approved.                         (signed) KATHY HOCHUL
 
                                ______

summary: Enacts the consumer litigation funding act to promote consumer protections related to consumer litigation funding transactions; provides for contract requirements, including that the contract contain a no penalty provision for the prepayment of the funded amount prior to the settlement of their case; makes related provisions.
